verified_facts.statement: Ticket 101 is an open customer order for one Classic Bulldog Tee (SKU CC-TEE-WHITE), size S; the customer note says they need size S.
There are zero units of the requested SKU and size on hand, and the request cannot currently be fulfilled from stock.
The linked supplier is Bulldog Print Co, with a quoted lead time of 5 days.
Bulldog Print Co is blocked from shipping because it has one open unpaid invoice: invoice 501 for $840.00, due 2026-08-28 and 3 days overdue relative to shop operating date 2026-08-31.
Preparing a one-unit size S stock purchase was refused because the linked supplier is blocked by its unpaid invoice.
Accounting prepared invoice-payment proposal prop-5eb06189e458 for invoice 501, amount $840.00, pending human approval. No payment has been executed.

recommendation.summary: The order cannot be fulfilled now. Human approval is required for the pending $840 invoice-payment proposal. If the invoice is settled and the supplier is unblocked, prepare a one-unit size S restock for approval; only then can fulfillment proceed after stock arrives. Do not promise a delivery date.
recommendation.rationale: There is a one-unit stock shortfall, the supplier currently will not ship, and no restock purchase is prepared. The quoted five-day lead time is not a confirmed delivery date and cannot support a customer commitment.
recommendation.approval_reason: Settling the invoice involves money, and buying replacement stock involves a purchase; both require human approval.

limitations.impact: There is no replenishment in progress, so the customer order remains unfulfillable at present.
